reviews.texto: The whole Wolf team did an awesome job transforming my existing garage into a beautiful functional living space and extension of my kitchen area. It was exactly what I had envisioned. I am very happy with the results and would gladly recommend and hire them again!

I can't say enough about how good the finished product is. A car hit our house, so we needed repairs to our siding. We also had broken stairs in the front and back of our house, so decided to have them all redone at the same time. Wolf came, gave a reasonable estimate, started the work in a timely manner, and made sure I was satisfied before leaving. Can't recommend them enough.

I highly recommend Wolf Carpenters Service!

Julio and Gedson are great with explanations and they have a lot of good ideias to do an outstanding service at my home!

They did an addition in my property and I’m very very happy with results!

The Crew are very nice, clean and professional, highly recommend.

There are no words to describe how grateful and satisfied I am with the service Wolf Carpenters did in my home. My kitchen turned out completely beautiful, just the way I had imagined. The team is great, everyone is very polite and friendly. I recommend their work 100% :)

I had a great experience with the Wolf team in building my office. They were professional, attentive, and delivered a high-quality result within the established timeframe. I am very satisfied with the service provided and highly recommend Wolf to anyone looking for a reliable company for construction projects.

Julio and his team are absolutely amazing. They created an all season porch for my parents from start to finish. They really brought to life what my parents envisioned and wanted. Julio was easy to communicate with, very responsive, a hard worker, and keeps his word when he says he’ll be there. We are so fortunate to have had Julio and Wolf Carpenters services!

We used Wolf Construction to fix our deck and add ceiling access to our air conditioning unit. They were fantastic! The access panel ended up being a little more work than expected, but the end result was perfect. The ceiling looks great and they even added a fresh coat of paint to the wall. Highly recommend! Thank you Wolf Construction!
Excellent work. I was highly satisfied with the work. My condominium looks amazing. It was a pleasure working with wolfs painting and remodeling company.
